title: Remove false quarterly ranking snapshot identity
final_head_binding: Canonical handoff binds the exact final PR head containing this manifest via REVIEW_HEAD_SHA.

reproduced_defect_context.observed_defect: QuarterlyRanking.tsx hardcoded searchParams.get('snapshot')?.trim() ?? 'snap-2026-q3-final' and rendered it as Evaluation Context Snapshot ID on the 2026-Q4 view while also allowing a requested URL snapshot parameter to masquerade as the served current identity.

acceptance_verification.AC1_authoritative_snapshot_truth_and_url: Removed the hardcoded 'snap-2026-q3-final' fallback in QuarterlyRanking.tsx. Evaluation Context Snapshot ID now resolves from authoritative served ranking/recommendation owner data (ranking_snapshot_id / rankingSnapshotId on active/ranked rows, falling back to matched saved owner recommendation snapshot identity when row-level snapshot is absent) or renders 'unavailable' when no served identity exists. A requested URL ?snapshot=... query parameter never masquerades as the served Snapshot ID and is displayed separately as 'Requested Snapshot:' when it differs from the served identity.
acceptance_verification.AC2_preserve_owner_recommendation_formul: Preserved useSavedProposals, ProposalCell (including row-level evaluator_run_id and ranking_snapshot_id provenance), quarterly selection, score formulas, and read-only human-decision boundaries without any BFF, schema, protocol, mode, provider, or business action changes.
